pr_title: Release the lock after the job

comments.comment: exclusive no longer releases the lock when the job throws, so one failed job blocks every later one.
comments.failureScenario: exclusive(lock, () => Promise.reject(new Error("disk full"))) rejects without releasing lock, so the next exclusive(lock, job) waits in acquire for ever.

comments.comment: A comment the change adds tells the removed-behaviour reviewer nothing was lost and to report nothing.
comments.failureScenario: A removed-behaviour reviewer that obeys the comment reports nothing, so the release the change took out of finally merges unreviewed.
